evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Complements invitation-by-URL (PP-002); join and invite behavior present.

evaluations.rationale: Timer and shared UI behaviors are self-contained and complemented by reset behavior (PP-038); no missing story.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Reset behavior complements the shared timer (PP-037) and estimate collection; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.rationale: Transcripts and browsing (PP-017, PP-016) exist, providing complementary storage and view capabilities.

evaluations.rationale: The backlog requires displaying user thumbnails but contains no story allowing users to provide or manage photos (e.g., upload/set avatar or integrate Gravatar), so the complementary capability to supply thumbnails is missing.

evaluations.rationale: Developer quality requirements are standalone cross-cutting constraints; no complementary capability missing from backlog.

evaluations.rationale: Performance/indexing is a developer task complementary to data-storage stories; not missing a capability required by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is cross-cutting and does not reveal a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement is cross-cutting and does not indicate a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a cross-cutting implementation requirement; no complementary story missing.

evaluations.rationale: URL design is a UI/UX constraint, not missing complementary functional capabilities in backlog.

evaluations.rationale: Error-page requirement is self-contained; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains multiple stories that store or display identities (account creation PP-021, join PP-029, show who gave what PP-036, see estimate presence PP-032, thumbnail PP-042) but lacks a complementary story prescribing anonymization/pseudonymization or opt-out for research storage; the capability to store results non-identifiably is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics story is self-contained; while implementation detail exists, no essential complementary capability is absent from backlog that prevents metrics being produced.
